answer: Entry requires a work license: 40 units locked for 90 days, plus four skill proofs spread over 14 days — grading a violet pigment batch, surveying a basalt quarry, and routing a harbor delivery are typical tasks. Each proof is checked by seven randomly drawn auditors, and a failed or copied proof forfeits the deposit. A sybil farmer wanting 100 identities must lock 4,000 units at once and pass 400 distinct proofs, so cost rises linearly in capital and steeply in effort; the registry verifies lock age, auditor signatures, and proof uniqueness before any reward vests.
